reason: My buyers know me, they buy because I pick up the phone and shake hands at the fair. I might take the free 15-company sample out of curiosity, but I would not put EUR 1,500 down this month for cold emails from a Sofia agency.
objection: In wholesale nobody switches supplier because of a cold email; they switch because they trust a person. I doubt meetings from outreach turn into orders, and I do not want strangers writing to my market in my company's name.
would_change_my_mind: Talking to a past client who is a distributor like me, not a logistics company, and hearing that the meetings actually became repeat orders.
